svg.title: Long Island (NY) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Long Island; 2: Cutchogue; 3: Mattituck; 4: Jamesport; 5: Peconic; 6: Southold; 7: Riverhead; 8: New York; 9: Bridgeport; 10: New Haven; 11: Stamford; 12: New London

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
